pro_course_detail.title: Beginners
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson is all about you, beginners who are starting from scratch. I'm going to help you with pronunciation, how to form a sentence,  the tones, learning new words and give you some examples using those words. I will provide you the tools and documents you need to learn. We're going to practice and do quizzes together.  Let's get the ball rolling!

I will talk to my students through Skype and I will share pictures, materials, websites and children books pdf through Skype. So make sure you give me your Skype id. I also use a google docs as a tool to communicate with my students. I can type bigger fonts right there to make it easier for students to read. We will learn how to conjugate the tones, combine consonants and vowel to form a syllable or a word, consonants classification, etc.
Learning Thai requires daily efforts, you have to practice drawing alphabet, tone markers, vowels, etc by yourself, and I will show you how to make new words, expand your vocabulary and how to sequence the structure of sentences. I will definitely guide you all the way and give you homework every time we meet, so that you can review the lesson and help you prove yourself that you can understand what you have learned.
From my experiences with a lot of students, we can finish all of consonants and vowels within 7-10 lessons. That is an incredibly quick process because I don’t want you to waste time on reading words that don’t make any sense, I will usually focus on words that have meaning, so that you can built up your own vocabulary words as quick as possible.
Hope to see you guys soon and be a part of your journey of learning Thai and wish to see your improvements!

pro_course_detail.description:
📸🎥🖌"A picture paints a thousand words" is an English idiom which means that any idea can be explained by a single image or that an image of a subject explains it better than a verbal description does.🖌🎥📸

Let's put this to the test. 

Join me for a lesson where we will test your skill in analysing, comprehending and using your creativity in adding meaning to pictures. 

Lesson Objectives: 
📸 To initiate ideas and discussion about a specific picture-related topic.
📸 To stimulate creativity.
📸 To improve vocabulary 🗣 🗣 🗣 
📸 To enhance our skills of paying attention to detail. 🔎🔎🔎
📸 To instil confidence in our ability to verbalise a situation. 

Lesson Structure:
🖌 Using a picture supplied to them, students will be asked to relay the facts pertaining to the picture. Emphasis on "attention to detail"  and "exactness". 
🖌 Vocabulary and their context in relation to the topic will be discussed. 
🖌 Using their creativity, students then have 1 minute ⌚ to prepare a fictional story using the picture and their new found vocabulary as a basis for the story-line. 
🖌 Question ❓ time.

Who is this for?
🎥 ANYONE with at least a beginner level of English. 

If you have an imagination,  a creative side or just want to practice,  then this FUN lesson is for you

5. ผม/ดิฉันชอบ... (Phom/Dichan chop...) - I like...

Practice Activity (5 minutes)
Use Kahoot for an interactive quiz on today's lesson

This beginner-friendly lesson aims to introduce basic Thai phrases and encourage student participation.

The best way to increase your confidence in spoken English is to practice. This class is perfect if you have BIG language goals but lack confidence in how to achieve them. It is my top priority that you feel empowered in my classes and know that you have the ability to learn English in a supportive and fun environment.

I will 
✓ always take notes during our conversations 
✓ always correct pronunciation and grammatical errors after you are finished speaking 
✓ send you feedback with homework (if you request)

Are you interested in looking at some interesting, but random daily topics? Want to discuss the tipping culture in your country? Do you want to express your thoughts and broaden your vocabulary on social media? How about languages? Or being a vegan? These are just some of the topics that I can challenge you with and help you to become fluent in everyday topics.
If you are as excited as I am about this opportunity to improve your English, I encourage you to book a lesson with me!

pro_course_detail.title: Разговорная практика| Conversation Practice
pro_course_detail.description:
Хочешь выучить русский язык, но не знаешь с чего начать? Или, может быть, вы хотите просто хорошо поговорить на русском языке? Я буду рад помочь вам! В этом уроке я помогу вам улучшить ваши разговорные навыки. Мы сосредоточимся на обсуждении широкого круга тем, развитии вашей речи посредством обмена мнениями и обсуждения различных тем исходя из ваших интересов. Также я могу подготовить тексты на разные интересные темы. Сначала я буду читать, чтобы вы могли слышать мое произношение, затем вы могли читать и практиковать слова, которые труднее читать, пока вы не произнесете их правильно. Наша цель будет заключаться в том, чтобы улучшить вашу уверенность и беглость речи, увеличить словарный запас и улучшить произношение.
Если вы так же, как и я, взволнованы этой возможностью улучшить свой русский язык, я приглашаю вас записаться на урок со мной!

Do you want to learn Russian language but don't know how to start? Or maybe you want just to have good conversation in Russian? I will be glad to help you! In this lesson, I will help you improve your speaking skills. We will focus on discussing a wide range of topics, developing your speech through an exchange of opinions and discussing various topics based on your interests. I can also prepare texts on various interesting topics. First I will read so you can hear my pronunciation, then you can read and practice the harder words until you get them right. Our goal will be to improve your confidence and fluency, expand your vocabulary and improve your pronunciation.
If you are as excited as I am about this opportunity to improve your Russian, I encourage you to book a lesson with me!

pro_course_detail.title: Türkçe konuşma dersi | Conversation Practice
pro_course_detail.description:
Derslerimi her öğrencinin ihtiyaçlarına göre ayarladığımdan dolayı, bu kurs tüm seviyeler için mükemmeldir! İster Beginner ister Intermediate seviyede olun, bu ders genel konuşma yeteneğinizi ve akıcılığınızı bir sonraki seviyeye taşımak için tasarlanmıştır. Farklı konularda fikir paylaşımı ve tartışma yoluyla konuşma akıcılığınızı geliştirmeye odaklanacağız. Ayrıca sizin ilgi çekici konuları içeren metinler de hazırlayabilirim. Önce ben okuyacağım, böylece telaffuzumu duyabilirsin, sonra okuması daha zor olan kelimeleri doğru söyleyene kadar okuyup pratik yapabiliriz.

This course is perfect for all levels as I adjust my lessons to each student's needs! Whether you are a Beginner or Intermediate level, this lesson is designed to push your overall speaking ability and fluency to the next level. It will also, greatly increase your confidence in speaking. We will focus on discussing a wide range of topics, developing your speaking fluency through sharing opinions and discussion. I can also prepare texts with different interesting topics. I will read first, so you can hear my pronunciation, then you can read and practice words which are harder to read, until you say them right. Our focus will be to improve your speaking confidence and fluency, expand your vocabulary and improve your pronunciation.

pro_course_detail.description:
General Russian course for all levels is aimed to improve your Russian language skills in listening,  talking, reading, grammar, writing, and vocabulary development.
You'll be able to improve your accuracy (how correct your Russian is) and fluency (how well you can communicate), as well as your pronunciation, reading skills (intonation. etc.), and ability to comprehend information. 
The better and more precisely you can express your ideas and thoughts, the more professional you sound and the better people will understand you. 
I like to have classes in an informal way so you won't be bored and that's going to make a learning process fast and efficient. If you are as excited as I am about this opportunity to improve your Russian, I encourage you to book a lesson with me!

Общий курс русского языка для всех уровней направлен на улучшение ваших навыков русского языка в аудировании, разговорной речи, чтении, грамматике, письме и развитии словарного запаса.
Вы сможете улучшить свою точность (насколько правильно вы говорите по-русски) и беглость (насколько хорошо вы можете общаться), а также ваше произношение, навыки чтения (интонация и т. д.) и способность понимать информацию.
Чем лучше и точнее вы сможете выразить свои идеи и мысли, тем профессиональнее вы будете звучать и тем лучше вас поймут люди.
